import subprocess

# Debug render_inner_html behavior
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import TocExtension
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=[TocExtension()])
text = "# This is `code` and `this` too."
md.convert(text)

# Find h1 element
for el in md.parser.root.iter():
    if el.tag == "h1":
        print(f"h1 before toc processing:")
        print(f"  text: {repr(el.text)}")
        for i, c in enumerate(el):
            print(f"  child[{i}]: tag={c.tag}, text={repr(c.text)}, tail={repr(c.tail)}")
        
        # Try manual serialization
        parts = []
        if el.text:
            parts.append(el.text)
        for child in el:
            parts.append(md.serializer(child))
            if child.tail:
                parts.append(child.tail)
        manual = "".join(parts)
        print(f"  manual render_inner_html: {repr(manual)}")
        
        # Try using tostring on a wrapper
        wrapper = ET.Element("div")
        if el.text:
            wrapper.text = el.text
        for child in el:
            wrapper.append(child)
            if child.tail:
                wrapper[-1].tail = child.tail
        wrapped = md.serializer(wrapper)
        print(f"  wrapper serialization: {repr(wrapped)}")
        
        break
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr)
